def factor_range_pressure_smooth_vol_gate(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    # primary mechanism: cycle range pressure over 60 days
    buy_pressure = (close - df_copy["low"]).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    sell_pressure = (df_copy["high"] - close).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    total_range = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    range_pressure = (buy_pressure - sell_pressure) / total_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    # lightweight modifier: downside volume participation with smooth attenuation
    ret = close.pct_change()
    down_vol = volume.where(ret < 0, 0.0).rolling(60, min_periods=30).sum()
    total_vol = volume.rolling(60, min_periods=30).sum().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    down_ratio = down_vol / total_vol
    median_down_ratio = down_ratio.rolling(60, min_periods=20).median()
    safe_median = median_down_ratio.clip(lower=1e-8)
    # continuous excess above median (0 when at or below median)
    excess = (down_ratio / safe_median - 1.0).clip(lower=0.0)
    # smooth attenuation: scale ~1 at median, ~0.77 at +20% excess, asymptote 0.7
    scale = 1.0 - 0.3 * np.tanh(excess / 0.2)
    factor = range_pressure * scale
    df_copy["factor_range_pressure_smooth_vol_gate"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_range_pressure_smooth_vol_gate"]
